cultural.vision_reason: The image shows an iron dagger/short sword with a carved wooden handle and sheath (plaited-cord pattern), attributed by the museum to the Shona of Zimbabwe. This is a traditional weapon type consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: sword; knife
physical.summary:
(Description from Christy slip)
Straight leaf-shaped iron dagger with central longitudinal ridge. The handle and sheath are of a dark brown wood, the former being of oval section with a conical butt. The sheath is in two longitudinal pieces bound with thongs, and has a foot-like projection at the point protruding at right angles. Near the other end is a raised loop cut from the solid, through which is passed a loop of soft thong. The whole of one side of the sheath and handle is covered with carved ornament resembling plaited cord.
